# `scene.set_metadata`: Set metadata

Sets or removes free-form JSON metadata on an object.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(keys log keys)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: custom properties, extras, user data

Metadata travels with the object in `.p3d` files and, where the format allows, into exports (glTF extras).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `remove` | `string[]` | `[]` | Keys to remove. |
| `set` | `Record<string, unknown>` | `{}` | Keys to set to JSON values. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"set":{"material_hint":"oak"},"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1) metadata: material_hint`
